tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python -c "
import openpyxl
wb=openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws=wb.active
for r in range(2, ws.max_row+1):
    ws.cell(r,1).value = '=VALUE(RIGHT(B{r},LEN(B{r})-1))'.format(r=r)
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('saved', ws.max_row)
"
